title: Exit plan with annual dry run
objective: Each customer contract has an exit plan listing data, in-flight item treatments, roles and timeline; an annual dry run performs a full export and reconciliation and records the result.
owner: Managing member of Echelon Foundry, LLC

title: Read-only termination mode
objective: Termination places a tenant in read-only mode in which export, reporting and viewing remain available and all mutating commands are refused; deletion can start only after customer confirmation or window expiry.
owner: Managing member of Echelon Foundry, LLC

title: Scheduled exports to customer-controlled storage
objective: Optional daily full or incremental export with manifest delivered to a customer-owned storage location, with delivery failures alerting both parties.
owner: Product owner, Unbound (proposed role; not appointed)
residual_risks: Protection of exports once in customer storage is the customer's responsibility.

title: Exit effective-time enforcement
objective: At the exit effective time, the tenant's payment origination, partner API clients and subscriptions are disabled by a single lifecycle transition, and the system refuses payment commands thereafter.
implementing_systems: Unbound tenant lifecycle and payment preparation (not built)
owner: Managing member of Echelon Foundry, LLC

title: Exit-friendly standard terms
objective: Standard agreement includes no exit or export fees, a published assistance rate card, termination for convenience, survival of data obligations and perpetual customer rights in exported data.
owner: Managing member of Echelon Foundry, LLC
